enum.name: MAV_ODID_RADIO_TECHNOLOGY
enum.description: Radio technology over which a Remote ID message was received.

entry.name: MAV_ODID_RADIO_TECHNOLOGY_BLE_LR
entry.description: OpenDroneID Bluetooth Long Range (BT5 Coded PHY).

entry.name: MAV_ODID_RADIO_TECHNOLOGY_WLAN_FR_DSE
entry.description: French Direct Remote ID (DSE, "dispositif de signalement électronique") WLAN beacon.

message.name: OPEN_DRONE_ID_RADIO_RX_INFORMATION
message.description: Auxiliary information about the radio signal on which an OpenDroneID (or other Remote ID) message was received, e.g. RSSI. Sent alongside the corresponding OPEN_DRONE_ID_* message and matched to it via id_or_mac and msg_crc.
message.field: MAC address or UAS ID of the transmitter, identical to id_or_mac in the associated OPEN_DRONE_ID_* message. See https://mavlink.io/en/services/opendroneid.html.

CRC-32 (IEEE 802.3, as computed by zlib crc32()) of the OpenDroneID messages in the associated OPEN_DRONE_ID_MESSAGE_PACK this reception information belongs to: messages[0 .. msg_pack_size * single_message_size). Only OPEN_DRONE_ID_MESSAGE_PACK is supported as associated message.
Message counter, copied from the received radio frame (the counter byte) Undefined for radio technologies that do not carry an ODID message counter.
Timestamp of reception (UNIX epoch or time since boot). 0 if unknown.
Index of the receiver/antenna on this component that received the signal, for components with multiple receivers. 0 if there is only one receiver or the index is unknown.
Radio technology over which the message was received.
WLAN channel of the received signal. 0 if unknown.
RSSI of the received signal. INT8_MAX if unknown.
Brand/manufacturer of the transmitting RID device, if known. Not NUL-terminated if exactly 16 chars. Empty if unknown.
Model of the transmitting RID device, if known. Not NUL-terminated if exactly 16 chars. Empty if unknown.
